claims.summary: Characteristic zero, M>=2, non-integer lambda, generic b. For the cluster degeneration (eps*b,1,-1) of the pair space with exponent lambda, the half-integral neck coefficient matrix (rescaled basis eps^-m g_m, eps^-m tau g_m of U_x + tau U_x, tau=-tanh(lambda artanh y)) has val det C[:,W_k]=k(k+1) on the windows W_k={-(M-k)..M-1+k} with leading coefficient +-t_1^k H_{M-k} det Gamma_k != 0; W_k is the unique minimizer of val-alpha*sum S for alpha in (k/M,(k+1)/M) within (0,1), with exactly W_{j-1},W_j at alpha=j/M. Hence the neck has M-1 binomial edges of slopes j/M and length 2M and carries exactly 2M(M-1) simple Weierstrass points for small eps.
claims.assessment: Working proof after one fresh-context medium review: Schur elimination of the identity block, Laplace bounds in two cases, staircase Hankel normality of tau, and generic nonvanishing of det Gamma_k, Gamma_k=[G_{m,D+1}-G_{m-1,D}-G_{m,M}G_{M-1,D}] (the last term found in review), by specializing prod(x-b_i) to x^M-c x^(M-k-1); transfer through the unit E by a unipotent column operator. Corrects the minimizing interval stated in the earlier window conjecture.
claims.rationale: Settles the neck of the cluster degeneration in every dimension, leaving the confluent bubble as the only uncertified component of generic Weierstrass simplicity.

relationships: Proves the window rule for every non-integer exponent (with corrected intervals).
Neck edges of the Wronskian from the half-integral class.

conj:cube-neck-windows.assessment: Proved (with the minimizing interval corrected from ((k-1)/M,k/M) to (k/M,(k+1)/M)) by the neck window theorem of 29 September 2026.

conj:cube-neck-windows-noninteger.assessment: Proved, with the minimizing intervals made precise, by the neck window theorem of 29 September 2026.
